description: This file contains implementation code related to HTTP compression support within libwebsockets, including validation, application, transformation, and destruction of compression contexts, as well as managing compression methods.

methods.name: int lws_http_compression_validate(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Validates and computes acceptable HTTP compression encodings based on the client's 'Accept-Encoding' header.

methods.name: int lws_http_compression_apply(struct lws * wsi,const char * name,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end,char decomp)
methods.description: Applies a specified compression encoding to the HTTP response, initializing the compression context.

methods.name: void lws_http_compression_destroy(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the compression context associated with a websocket instance.

methods.name: int lws_http_compression_transform(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len,enum lws_write_protocol * wp,unsigned char ** outbuf,size_t * olen_oused)
methods.description: Handles the compression transformation of outgoing data, managing internal buffers and states.

ctags.name: lws_http_compression_apply
ctags.signature: (struct lws * wsi,const char * name,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end,char decomp)

ctags.name: lws_http_compression_transform
ctags.signature: (struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len,enum lws_write_protocol * wp,unsigned char ** outbuf,size_t * olen_oused)
